paragraphs.text: 1. THAT general Car of yours, invoked by many a man, that comes to our libations, three-wheeled, meet for lauds,
paragraphs.original: समानमु त्यं पुरुहूतमुक्थ्यं रथं त्रिचक्रं सवना गनिग्मतम् ।
paragraphs.translit: samānamu tyaṃ puruhūtamukthyaṃ rathaṃ tricakraṃ savanā ganigmatam |

paragraphs.text: That circumambient Car, worthy of sacrifice, we call with our pure hymns at earliest flush of dawn.
paragraphs.original: परिज्मानं विदथ्यं सुवृक्तिभिर्वयं व्युष्टा उषसो हवामहे
paragraphs.translit: parijmānaṃ vidathyaṃ suvṛktibhirvayaṃ vyuṣṭā uṣaso havāmahe

paragraphs.text: 2. Ye, O Nasatyas, mount that early-harnessed Car, that travels early, laden with its freight of balm,
paragraphs.original: प्रातर्युजं नासत्याधि तिष्ठथः प्रातर्यावाणं मधुवाहनं रथम् ।
paragraphs.translit: prātaryujaṃ nāsatyādhi tiṣṭhathaḥ prātaryāvāṇaṃ madhuvāhanaṃ ratham |

paragraphs.text: Wherewith ye, Heroes, visit clans who sacrifice, even the poor man's worship where the priest attends.
paragraphs.original: विशो येन गच्छथो यज्वरीर्नरा कीरेश्चिद्यज्ञं होतृमन्तमश्विना
paragraphs.translit: viśo yena gacchatho yajvarīrnarā kīreścidyajñaṃ hotṛmantamaśvinā

paragraphs.text: 3. If to the deft Adhvaryu with the meath in hand, or to the Kindler firm in strength, the household friend,
paragraphs.original: अध्वर्युं वा मधुपाणिं सुहस्त्यमग्निधं वा धृतदक्षं दमूनसम् ।
paragraphs.translit: adhvaryuṃ vā madhupāṇiṃ suhastyamagnidhaṃ vā dhṛtadakṣaṃ damūnasam |

paragraphs.text: Or to the sage's poured libations ye approach, come thence, O Asvins, now to drink the offered meath.
paragraphs.original: विप्रस्य वा यत्सवनानि गच्छथोऽत आ यातं मधुपेयमश्विना
paragraphs.translit: viprasya vā yatsavanāni gacchatho'ta ā yātaṃ madhupeyamaśvinā
